quoteCart.title: Your quote request
quoteCart.empty: Your quote request is empty. Browse the catalog to add products.

quoteForm.title: Submit your quote request
quoteForm.intro: Tell us what you're interested in and how to reach you. Our team will follow up directly with pricing and availability — no payment is collected here.
quoteForm.phoneHelp: Include the country code, e.g. +1 555 010 0100. We text you a one-time code to confirm the number.
quoteForm.notesPlaceholder: Anything else we should know about your request?
quoteForm.ackLabel: I confirm I am 18 years of age or older and that these products are for research and laboratory use only, not for human consumption.
quoteForm.emptyCartTitle: No items in your quote request

quoteForm.phoneVerifiedOnSubmit: We'll ask you to verify your phone number when you submit.
quoteForm.signedOut: You've been signed out and your saved details were removed from this browser.
quoteForm.detailsCleared: Your saved details were cleared from this browser.

banner.title: Cookies and browser storage
banner.body: We use only the storage the site needs to work: a sign-in cookie, your quote cart and your language. We use no advertising or tracking. You can also let us remember your name, email and address on this device for next time.

footer.dataRequest: Data request (delete or access my data)

note.quote: We use these details only to verify your phone and answer your quote request.
note.feedback: We use these details only to read and reply to your message.
note.otp: We use your number only to send the verification code.

erase.title: Delete my data in this browser
erase.body: Signs you out and removes your quote cart, remembered details, unsent draft and cookie choice from this browser.
erase.done: Done — everything this site stored in this browser was removed.

dataRequest.title: Data request
dataRequest.intro: Ask us to delete, send you a copy of, or correct the personal data we hold about you. We reply within 30 days after confirming it is you.

types.access: Send me a copy of my data

dataRequest.emailHelp: Use the address you gave us, so we can confirm it is you by replying to it.
dataRequest.phoneHelp: The number you used for quote requests, if any.
dataRequest.successBody: Thank you. We will reply to your email address to confirm it is you, then act on your request within 30 days.

signIn.title: Verify your phone number
signIn.intro: We use your number only to confirm your quote request — this doesn't create an account. We text you a one-time code, and this browser then stays verified for 30 days.
signIn.cookieNote: A small cookie in this browser remembers that your number is verified.

feedback.title: Tell us what you think
feedback.intro: Missing a compound, or something unclear on the site? Send us a note.
feedback.messagePlaceholder: What would make Pep Club better for you?

confirmation.title: Quote request received
confirmation.body: Thank you — we've received your request. Our team will follow up by email with pricing and next steps shortly.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Questions about a product or your quote request? Reach us by phone.
